stories.headline: Ray-Ban Meta and Oakley Meta go on sale in the Philippines Nov. 10
stories.subtitle: EssilorLuxottica and Meta set a Nov. 10 launch date with local prices from P34,149 (Oakley HSTN) to P42,661 (Vanguard). Meta AI will work in Tagalog, but Muse stays US-only for now.

stories.headline: PAYDAY: Aces High launches today on Meta Quest
stories.subtitle: The heist shooter is out now on Quest 3 and 3S, leading November's Horizon+ lineup — a solid answer when customers ask what's new to play on Quest this month.

stories.headline: Muse gets a voice in the Muse app
stories.subtitle: Meta is rolling out voice and expressive avatars in the Muse app, so customers can talk to their Muse hands-free. It's in the app on mobile, web and Mac — not on the glasses yet.

stories.headline: Meta and Lionsgate bring The Hunger Games to Meta VR Glasses in 3D
stories.subtitle: Sunrise on the Reaping hits theaters in 3D and will come to Meta VR Glasses when they launch in spring 2027 — an early content hook for customers asking what's coming to the new headset.

stories.headline: US senators probe Meta AI glasses over privacy risks
stories.subtitle: Sens. Ron Wyden and Edward Markey gave Meta until Nov. 25 to answer nine questions on its camera glasses — accidental recording, indicator tampering, and whether bystander footage trains AI. Expect customers to ask about the recording light.
